parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({"model":"llama3.1:8b","stream":false,"think":false,"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"Classify which capability categories (zero, one, or a few) might be needed to respond to the user's message. Most messages need none at all - only include a category if it's genuinely likely needed." + " The capability/capabilities active in the immediately preceding turn of this conversation: " + ((() => { try { const c = $('Get Last Active Capability').first().json.capabilities; return (Array.isArray(c) && c.length) ? c.join(', ') : 'none'; } catch (e) { return 'none'; } })()) + ".
